title: A prospective clinical trial to evaluate the validity of smartwatches compared to standard ECG in obese participants during treadmill exercises. THE PREPARE BASKET TRIAL TASK I
summary:
Topic/Clinical Condition    
- A prospective clinical trial to assess the validity of smartwatches compared to standard ECG in obese participants during treadmill exercise. No specific clinical condition is required. Obese adults will be included regardless of comorbidities (except for exclusion criteria).

Objective	
- Evaluation of the safety and accuracy of smartwatches (Apple and Android types) compared to simultaneous standard ECG measurements in obese participants (body mass index ≥ 30) on a treadmill during various endurance exercises. The hypothesis for sample size calculation assumes a deviation of <10 bpm between the smartwatch measurement and the ECG measurement.

Study Design    
- The study is designed as a single-center, prospective trial. For each participant, the smartwatch measurement will be compared with the ECG measurement. Additionally, the walking distance (measured by the smartwatch) will be compared with the running distance on the treadmill.

Study design    
- Prospective, single-center

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-    Written informed consent
-    Willingness to participate
-    BMI ≥ 30
-    Ownership of a smartphone
Exclusion criteria:
-    under 18 years of age
-    BMI < 30
-    Currently pregnant or breastfeeding
-    Insufficient understanding of the content and objectives of the training program
-    ECOG score > 3
-    Participants who are unable to walk, run, or climb stairs
-    Participants with acute (or chronic) cardiovascular disease:
o    Acute myocardial infarction or unstable angina pectoris (acute phase) (I20.0, I21)
o    Uncontrolled arrhythmias with symptoms or hemodynamic impairment
o    Acute myocarditis or pericarditis (I30, I39, I40)
o    Suspected aneurysmal dissection
-    Uncontrolled, acutely decompensated heart failure (acute pulmonary edema) (J81)
-    Heart rate > 120 bpm, systolic blood pressure > 180 mmHg or diastolic
> 120 mmHg
-    Acute pulmonary embolism (I26)
-    Shortness of breath at rest (respiratory rate > 25/min)
-    Exertional dyspnea after climbing fewer than two flights of stairs
-    Chest pain at rest
-    Severe hypoxemia at rest or acute respiratory failure (J80)
-    Acute non-cardiopulmonary disease that impairs physical capacity or may worsen with exercise (e.g., infection, renal failure, thyrotoxicosis)
-    Mental impairment with inability to cooperate
-    Participants under legal guardianship or incarcerated
